kHelpPages:
INVISANT
Invisible assailant.
Armitive cannot hear your
footsteps. Kill all Armitive to
win. Track living Armitive
through walls. No fall damage.

INVISANT
Knife-only. {KNIFE_CONE} deg cone.
{KNIFE_RANGE} units of reach.
{KNIFE_LOW}-{KNIFE_HIGH} damage per hit.
No backstab bonus. Attacks at
{KNIFE_SPEED}% of normal speed.

INVISANT
After {STARVATION_ROUND_DELAY}s of live play, {STARVATION_COMBAT_DELAY}s
without dealing or taking
damage starts Starvation.
{STARVATION_DAMAGE} HP / {STARVATION_INTERVAL}s; after {STARVATION_ACCELERATION_DELAY}s:
{STARVATION_ACCELERATED_DAMAGE} HP / {STARVATION_ACCELERATED_INTERVAL}s until combat.

ARMITIVE
Armed fugitive. Find the
Invisant with firearms, blood,
and contact. Buy weapons
permitted by this server.
Win if any survive the timer.

ARMITIVE
Headshot damage to Invisant is
halved and capped at 90. One
headshot cannot kill a
full-health Invisant.
Timer ends: Invisant {TIMEOUT_RESULT}

ROUND END
The round result is final.
Kills after round end give no
XP, rank, or Invisant priority.
Keep earned priority and wait
for the next round.

ROTATION
Roles rotate each round. A
Armitive who kills an Invisant
gets priority to become Invisant
next round.

ROTATION
Otherwise, the longest-waiting
eligible player becomes
Invisant. Suicide forfeits
next-round eligibility.

RANKINGS
Type rank for current-team stats.
Kills and assists raise ratings;
deaths lower them. More combat
makes your record count more.

PROGRESSION
Kills, qualifying damage
assists, and completed-round
wins grant separate Invisant and
Armitive XP.

PROGRESSION
As Armitive, knife kills earn {KNIFE_XP}%
kill XP; pistol kills, {PISTOL_XP}%.
Levels grant upgrade points. In
chat, type upgrade for effects;
menu to spend or reset points.

KILL STREAKS
In 2v2+ rounds, the first enemy
kill earns First Blood: 125%
kill XP. Your second kill within
10s of the last earns 120%.

KILL STREAKS
Each later kill within 10s of
your last adds 10% kill XP, up
to 200% on your tenth kill. Only
you hear the sounds.
Type help to reopen this panel.
kCheatPages:
ESP AND WALLHACKS
Invisant are not made
transparent. The server does not
send Invisant players, or their
weapon and movement sounds, to
Armitive computers.

ESP AND WALLHACKS
ESP and wallhacks can only show
data a computer receives. With
no Invisant player data, they
cannot reveal or track an
Invisant.

ESP AND WALLHACKS
Armitive still see blood and
bullet impacts, and hear damage
sounds. Report suspicious
behavior to an administrator.
kKnownBugPages:
KNOWN LIMITATIONS
Source cannot change the stock scoreboard team headings.
Through-wall tracking uses lines.
Reload and switch animations may retain their normal speed.

AUDIO AND ASSETS
Custom voices, claws and models need working client downloads.
Local movement prediction silencing can depend on the client.
Type audio to choose voice categories.
